name: dsh-cc-switch-local
description: cc-switch 本地路由 + 自定义供应商：把 cc-switch 的本地路由、直连供应商和自建 OpenAI Chat Completions 供应商一起接进 DeepSeek Harness。

summary.en: Bridges the cc-switch local router, direct upstream providers, and your own OpenAI Chat Completions providers into DSH, with a settings panel to switch routes and manage providers.
summary.zh: 把 cc-switch 的本地路由、直连供应商和自建 OpenAI Chat Completions 供应商接进 DSH，并在设置里切换路由、管理供应商。

capabilities.en: Detects the running cc-switch local router (proxy_config, client configs, port health) and imports it as an anthropic-messages route shared with Claude Code.
capabilities.zh: 识别正在运行的 cc-switch 本地路由（proxy_config、客户端配置、端口探活），接成与 Claude Code 共用的一条 anthropic-messages 路由。

capabilities.en: Imports cc-switch providers directly, with local-route and direct-upstream modes switchable independently.
capabilities.zh: 直连导入 cc-switch 供应商，本地路由与直连上游两种模式可以分别开关、随时切换。

capabilities.en: Adds a CC Switch settings page to create, edit, and delete custom providers with openai-completions, openai-responses, or anthropic-messages.
capabilities.zh: 在设置里新增 CC Switch 页面，可增删改自定义供应商，API 格式支持 openai-completions / openai-responses / anthropic-messages。

capabilities.en: Registers a cc_switch_local tool with status, sync, plan, list, local-probe, and custom-provider actions.
capabilities.zh: 注册 cc_switch_local 工具，支持 status / sync / plan / list / local-probe 与自定义供应商增删。
